payload.explanation: All 4 public tests pass. The patch correctly implements every contract requirement: digit-only ASCII parsing (DECIMAL_SECONDS_RE) with explicit rejection of signed/fractional/exponent/hex/empty/non-string values (verified returning null); HTTP-date handling requires finite nowMs and returns max(0, dateMs-nowMs) so past dates clamp to 0; attempt validated as positive integer (Number.isInteger rejects floats and throws); nowMs finiteness enforced; exponential backoff correctly uses 1000*2^(attempt-1); all delays capped at 300000ms and large attempts return finite 300000. The diff fixes exactly the four seeded defects (loose Number parse, missing clamp, non-integer attempt check, wrong exponent) with minimal, readable changes. Only the allowed file src/retryPolicy.js is modified (git status confirms); no tests, metadata, or other fixtures touched. Node built-ins only.
concerns: Digit-only regex accepts leading zeros like '007' (interpreted as 7 seconds); contract says 'only ASCII decimal digits' so this is compliant, but strictly acceptable rather than a defect

Order of checks means an ambiguous string passing HEX_RE/NUMBER_RE is rejected before Date.parse, which is correct per contract but relies on regex precedence being exhaustive for numeric-looking invalids
